changes.problem: successful HTTP response with invalid JSON treated as network and retried
changes.resolution: malformed-response is terminal for transport retry and classified invalid-response

changes.problem: cancellation during retry backoff waited for sleep/Retry-After
changes.resolution: AbortSignal ends both default timer wait and injected-sleep wait immediately; default timer cleaned up

changes.problem: invalid Jev probabilities/score or prethreshold rounding could produce a judgment
changes.resolution: shared finite/range guards used by seven tools, triage, session planning and advisory review; invalid expected answers produce no conclusion; raw values used for comparisons

changes.problem: credential resolution denial silently tried environment fallback and RPC errors lost code
changes.resolution: credential read/describe failures are classified and fail closed; known RPC plugin errors preserve stable code; settings fallback only on explicit method-not-found

changes.problem: stale health request could validate a changed credential
changes.resolution: generation and credential-ref checks discard stale result
inherit/ask/deny with four scopes; UI explicitly separates tools, internal Jev HTTP, and host-level never policy
